summary: Via Renewables, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the full redemption of 1,884,935 shares of its 8.75% Series A Fixed-to-Floating Rate Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock at $25.00 per share in cash, plus $0.59928 per share for accrued dividends through June 30, 2026. The company initiated the mandatory redemption using cash. The board did not issue a recommendation as this is a contractual redemption. Redemption will be processed through DTC and Equiniti Trust Company, with payment made on June 30, 2026. This return of capital reduces the preferred equity overhang. What to watch: successful clearing of the redemption and potential impact on common equity value.
